notes:
Stage 1 of the redacted print: for ten minutes after a press in DEBUG, RecCheck copies what Windows spools to the printer and shows what the job is made of, so the departures report can be read on its way to the printer. Nothing is sent to protel or to the printer, and nothing is watched outside those ten minutes.

The receipt cards under the serial-number search now show the whole guest name from protel's in-house list, like the rows above them. The red LEAVING TODAY mark and the receipts dot are built on the receipt's own name — completed from protel's list where the report cut it, never the room's name — so the arriving guest's paper is never marked. A room is named after its checked-in guest when protel lists more than one row for it.
